note: Curated project outputs. These are real examples produced by design-garden's own workflow; they are gallery exhibits, not community submissions and not votes.

items.title: 修车铺落地页
items.note: 用真实营业时间替掉“Open today”的谎。
items.noteEn: Real weekly hours replaced a static “Open today” claim that would lie every Monday.

items.title: 爵士咖啡馆开业海报
items.note: 同一主题的两套结构：一束聚光，一张被裁切的唱片。
items.noteEn: Two structures for one subject: a single spotlight, and a cropped record where type becomes the image.

items.title: 植物养护图标 8 枚
items.note: 16px 版本重新画，不是把 64px 缩小。
items.noteEn: The 16px exports were redrawn, not scaled down from 64px.

items.title: 花店周年海报
items.note: 画面里留着 [店名] 占位——不知道的事实不编。
items.noteEn: The [shop name] slot stays visible: an unknown fact is not invented.

items.title: 仓库社交预览图
items.note: 一张图说清“会生长的设计技能”，没有堆功能列表。
items.noteEn: One image says “a design skill that grows”, without a feature list.
